subject: Operational questions: EU-only inference & proof-of-deletion timeline

messages:
From: Sophie Tremblay <sophie.tremblay@brixtonhealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: privacy@brixtonhealth.com
Date: Wed, 7 Jun 2028 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Operational questions: EU-only inference & proof-of-deletion timeline

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We liked the latency profile for EU inference, but our legal/privacy team raised detailed operational questions before we proceed with pilots. High-level asks below — can you confirm by EOD Friday whether Redwood can provide these for a contract amendment?

1) Proof-of-deletion: For user/data deletion requests originating from our EU tenant, can you provide a signed artifact for each deletion that shows: deletion token, object IDs deleted, timestamp, and a hash/assertion that the object(s) were removed from all live stores and backups? If not per-deletion, is a daily aggregated attestation possible?

2) Backup retention & deletion propagation: How long do backups exist post-delete and what is the expected timeline for deletion propagation to immutable backups and offsite replicas? We need a max timeframe for legal hold and deletion timelines.

3) SCCs / Schrems II considerations: Our counsel asks whether adding SCCs is sufficient in light of your control plane and ops support (some Redwood admin consoles are US-hosted). What contractual and technical mitigations do you offer (KMS in-region, operator access restrictions, audit trails)?

4) Evidence for audits: If we run an annual EU audit, can you supply a runbook and logs demonstrating the deletion flow, and will a redacted export of operator access logs be available?

If you can share a short operational note (1-2 pages) and an example deletion evidence template that would be ideal.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Tremblay
Data Protection Lead, Brixton Health

--

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tremblay <sophie.tremblay@brixtonhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Jun 2028 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Operational questions: EU-only inference & proof-of-deletion timeline

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kim (legal) and Rishi (privacy/product) to confirm specifics. I kicked off a quick internal takeaway so we can reply with concrete timelines and artifacts.

Preliminary answers (operational summary):
- Deletion evidence: We can provide either per-deletion receipts or a daily rolled-up attestation. Receipt contents: deletion request ID, affected object keys, UTC timestamp, storage bucket/object path, and a SHA-256 digest of the deleted object metadata. Receipts are signed by our service key.

- Backups & replication: Primary copies for EU-only tenants live in EU regions. Backups (incremental snapshots) are retained for up to 14 days by default; longer retention can be contractually configured. Deletion propagation to live primary storage is immediate (within seconds); snapshot compaction and physical removal from immutable backup stores is best-effort and can take up to 30 days in our current standard config. We can commit to a 30-day max for the pilot with an option to tighten via a Dedicated/Private deployment.

- SCCs & mitigations: SCCs accepted in the DPA are our baseline. Complementary technical mitigations available: EU KMS key ownership (customer-managed key in AWS KMS/EU HSM), in-region control plane option (Private deployment), operator access whitelist + just-in-time access with recorded sessions, and retention of audit trails for operator actions.

- Audit evidence: We can produce a runbook, an "evidence bundle" (logs + receipts), and a redacted operator-access ledger for audits. For per-deletion proof, we'll attach a sample deletion-evidence-template.xlsx and a simplified data-flow diagram for EU-only inference.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kim to confirm contract language and SCC modules we should add.
2) Rishi to confirm backup compaction timeline commitments for the pilot.
3) We deliver the two attachments (diagram + evidence template) and a proposed 2-week pilot window to validate deletion propagation.

I'll send the attachments in a follow-up; flagging aditya to coordinate the pilot schedule with your team.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tremblay <sophie.tremblay@brixtonhealth.com>, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Jun 2028 10:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Operational questions: EU-only inference & proof-of-deletion timeline

Hi Sophie (and team) — thanks for raising these. From a legal/compliance standpoint we recommend the following approach, which we've used successfully with other EU healthcare customers: 

1) Contractual baseline: Insert SCCs (EU Commission standard contractual clauses) in the DPA + add a short schedule describing supplemental measures. Draft language we propose includes:
   - Confirmation that primary processing and backups for the EU tenant are hosted in EU regions;
   - Customer-managed KMS key residency in EU and the obligation for Redwood to enforce crypto-separation such that key material does not leave the EU;
   - Operator access: access is role-based, time-limited, and recorded; logs provided upon justified audit request.

2) Technical mitigations (to be specified as "supplemental measures"):
   - Option A: Private deployment (control plane in-customer VPC) — strongest guarantee;
   - Option B: In-region control plane + strict egress rules + customer-managed KMS (recommended for speed of onboarding);
   - Oblige Redwood to provide a deletion-evidence artifact for each bulk deletion request or daily rolled attestations when volume makes per-deletion impractical.

3) Deletion/Snapshots: We need product to confirm that snapshots and offsite replicas are either removable within the committed period or that encrypted keys are destroyed such that data is irrecoverable. For the pilot, a 30-day maximum physical removal is acceptable if coupled with key-destruction guarantees for older snapshots.

4) Audit support: Redwood to provide a documented runbook, sample evidence export, and redacted operator access logs. We will include a clause for reasonable assistance for regulatory audits.

Operational ask from our side (to Redwood): please produce (by Friday EOD) the short operational note Naomi mentioned and the two attachments she referenced. Also confirm whether you can commit to a 30-day max snapshot removal for the pilot, and if key destruction for older snapshots is feasible.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Hi Sophie — attaching the two artifacts (see attachments). Quick summary and proposed timeline so we have clear next steps: 

Summary of commitments for pilot (2-week technical validation):
- Deletion evidence: per-deletion receipts available via API; if volume is >1000 deletes/day, we will supply daily rolled attestations.
- Snapshot removal: commit to max 30 days for the pilot; we'll implement key-destruction for snapshots older than 30 days to render them unrecoverable (technical note included in the diagram).
- SCCs + supplemental measures: we will accept SCCs in DPA and provide customer-managed KMS in EU for the pilot. Operator access will be time-limited and logged.

Action items (owners):
- Naomi: deliver evidence template and data-flow diagram (attached) — DONE (attachments: redwood-eu-data-flow-diagram.pdf; deletion-evidence-template.xlsx).

Thanks — looking forward to moving ahead.
